explain XXXXX in english without using word XXXXX

i'm studying english, i am doing a course in english writing. we did the first 2 chapters and then we finished chapter 3. 
for the rest of our course, we are to write about 1 sentence in english every day and when we are done writing about one sentence, we have to fill in another sentence in english. we can't repeat the same sentence because it wouldn't be correct. for example:
i am studying english, do you know what i am doing? do you know what time is it?
but, when you write "studying english", it won't be "studying english", it will be "doing" (studying) with a verb.
can anyone explain me the reason and what is the correct way to write "studying english" without using "doing" with verb?

a:

in general, when you want to write, say, “i am studying english”, what you want to say is that you are studying, which is an activity. it has a beginning, an end, and it has to be done. it's your work to do it.
you’re allowed to say “i am reading english novels”, but that�
